content.comment_body: Hello, this is my first post here. I've almost finished setting up my first [product_name] installation, and I'm wondering if the [product_name] [article_no] can be configured to start its program automatically when power is applied. I have the initialization flag M8 in my ladder logic—how should I use its output? Is manual selection with cursors always necessary to start each time? Thank you in advance, [user_name]

Hi, The [product_name] program needs to be started using a menu command on the module itself or via a PC connection. Then M8 is "ON" for one program cycle as a flag. If the program is running and there's a power outage, the [product_name] program will run automatically once power resumes, and M8 will be "ON" for one cycle as well. Best regards, [user_name]
Hi, If the [product_name] is in RUN mode and then powered off and back on, the program will automatically start running. You can find more information in the [product_name] manual. Hope this helps.
Hi, [user_name]. Here are all the manuals for [product_name]: [url]

The project is working well! Had some last-minute nerves on my first project. Very pleased with the hardware, software, and the helpful advice from everyone here. Thank you all. Looking forward to tackling the next [product_name] solution. [user_name]
